name: Shwetavahana Riverine League
notes: The mercantile nation. Silvershore descendants who own the banks, locks and river tolls of the Saraswati and Godavari. Descendants of the Silvershore river-lords and Indus canal-masters: a financial and cartographic nation of banking houses, locks and river tolls. A nation of the Age of Machinery, on the pre-Shattering chart.
